parsed.rationale: All four participating records are `type-alias-object` entries with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, located exclusively under `Tests/` subdirectories (`RadioPlayerControllerTests.swift`, `PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift` at lines 18 and 99, and `SoundPlayerTests.swift`) across two separate packages (`Playback` and `PartyHorn`). Although the context flags report `is_mock=false` and `is_test=false`, the file paths and the canonical mock-naming convention (`MockAudioSession`, `Mocks/` directory) make clear these are test-support type aliases whose name collision is incidental to their shared domain (audio session mocking) rather than evidence of extractable shared logic. Because the records carry no fields and straddle two distinct test packages, consolidation would couple unrelated test targets without reducing any real duplication.
